notes.title: THE LIQUID JET demo is out
notes.notes:
Hello fellow [i]weirdos[/i]!

The demo for [b]The Liquid Jet[/b] is now out for Steam Next Fest!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RvyqEsb.gif[/img]

It is an atmospheric, offbeat but dreamy night's tale of a girl going to a warehouse rave party with her friends, where she'll go to experience a long, profound bad (or maybe more like weird?) trip.

It is drenched in equal doses of nostalgia, psychedelia, eeriness and fun. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7GIgkgO.gif[/img]

Get into it.
Get immersed.
Get liquid!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280810/The_Liquid_Jet/

And, also get glitchy as [b]GLITCH DADDY[/b] will be 50% off for the next ~10 days or so :)

notes.title: Announcing THE LIQUID JET!
notes.notes:
Hello there fellow weirdos :)

I present you the store page for our upcoming game, called [b]The Liquid Jet[/b].
It is about a girl visiting a forest warehouse rave party along with her friends, then going to experience a prolonged, weird trip.
It is expected to be released during Spring 2025.

See more and [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] at
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280810

XO XO
Take care

notes.title: The GLITCH DADDY original soundtrack is out now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 
we just dropped the [b]GLITCH DADDY[/b] Original Soundtrack.
It features 24 tracks, ranging from dream pop, indie rock, reggae dub and electronic beats to glitched-out soundscapes and harsh ambient.
In a way it is an audio retelling of the game itself, containing all the music, but also manual recreations of the interactively triggered combinations of sounds making up most of the second half of it.

Please enjoy :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3063990/Glitch_Daddy_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Daddy's home... GLITCH DADDY is OUT.
notes.notes:
After a (brutal) year in the making, [b]GLITCH DADDY[/b] has finally arrived, for all of you to taste.

Get ready for our new offering, something wildly evocative, provocative and trippy, but at the same time probably our most narratively clear and emotionally concrete work yet.

Thanks to everyone who helped making it happen, and also to everyone who expressed how they wanted it to happen, which also helped making it happen, in a way.

I hope you enjoy it.
XO XO

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6XWNFqb.png[/img]

notes.title: The GLITCH DADDY teaser demo is out!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I just got a teaser demo for the upcoming [b]GLITCH DADDY[/b] out.

It is a short one, clocking at around ~15 minutes, and it is essentially the intro level from the main game, a dream our protagonists has just before the main story starts taking place (think of it as a little showcase of aesthetics, along with a few of the basic mechanics).

I decided to keep it there, since I believe it is pretty neat and specific aesthetics and style-wise. Of course the game takes several left-field turns after that, but you can now have a first taste of it. :)

So tune in for [b]GLITCH DADDY[/b], and please spread the word if you enjoy it.
I hope you will

xx
SAD MASK PARTY

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LVyNP6c.png[/img]
